# libs-gui tests that cannot pass on Android under the headless backend.
#
# The headless backend draws nothing: every DPS primitive in
# HeadlessGState is an empty body and HeadlessFontEnumerator finds no
# font.  These tests need a backend that rasterizes, so they are
# expected to fail until an Android backend exists.
#
# Each entry was measured against a Linux control running the SAME
# libs-gui commit and the SAME headless backend commit, so the only
# variable is the platform.  A test listed here fails or skips on Linux
# too.  A test NOT listed here that fails is a regression.
#
# On Linux most of these skip cleanly, because the drawing attempt
# raises and the test's own guard catches it.  On Android nothing
# raises, so the test runs on and fails an assertion instead.

NSApplication/applicationIconImage
NSAttributedString/headIndentDrawing
NSBox/rendering
NSButton/rendering
NSClipView/rendering
NSColorPanel/render
NSColorWell/rendering
NSControl/rendering
NSDatePicker/rendering
NSDrawer/render
NSFontPanel/config
NSFontPanel/render
NSForm/rendering
NSImageView/rendering
NSLevelIndicator/rendering
NSMatrix/click
NSMatrix/rendering
NSOpenPanel/render
NSOutlineView/rendering
NSProgressIndicator/rendering
NSSavePanel/render
NSScrollView/rendering
NSSegmentedControl/rendering
NSSlider/interact
NSSlider/rendering
NSSplitView/rendering
NSSplitViewController/render
NSStackView/rendering
NSStepper/interact
NSTabView/rendering
NSTabViewController/render
NSTableView/click
NSTableView/rendering
NSTextField/rendering
NSTextView/cursorRectInvalidation
NSView/rendering
NSWindow/frameContent
NSWindow/windowRender
NSWindowController/lifecycle
